title: Reprogramming human amniotic fluid stem cells to functional pluripotency by manipulation of culture conditions.
protocol: Thaw Matrigel on ice overnight.
Dilute thawed Matrigel 1:2 using ice-cold KO-DMEM and immediately aliquot into 15 ml chilled centrifuge tubes (1 ml/tube).
Store aliquots at -80°C until use.
Thaw 1 ml stock aliquot of Matrigel overnight at 4°C.
Dilute thawed Matrigel 1:15 using ice cold KO-DMEM.
Aliquot 1 ml/well for a 6-well plate using chilled pipette tips.
Swirl to coat plate surface evenly.
Incubate plates at 37°C for 1 hour or at 4°C overnight.
Transfer plates kept at 4°C to 37°C for at least 30 minutes before use.
Aspirate the Matrigel solution from coated plates.
Replace with 3 ml of pre-warmed Nutristem media and place back into incubator to equilibrate.
Passage cells onto the prepared plates after a minimum of 10 minutes.
Dissolve 20,000 U of collagenase Type IV in 100 ml KO-DMEM.
Add the dissolved collagenase and other components to a 250 ml filter unit and filter.
Aliquot into 15 ml sterile tubes and store at -20°C until use.
Thawed collagenase solution can be stored at 4°C for up to 1 week.
Take one DMEM bottle and remove 60 ml of liquid.
Thaw one aliquot each of L-Glutamine, Penicillin/Streptomycin, and FBS in a 37°C water bath.
Add the thawed solutions to the DMEM bottle.
Gently swirl the bottle to mix without touching the ridges.
Keep isolation medium at 4°C for up to 2 weeks.
Pre-warm a small aliquot of isolation medium in a 37°C water bath before use.
Remove 5 ml of Nutristem from a 500 ml bottle and replace it with 5 ml of thawed Penicillin/Streptomycin.
Gently swirl the bottle to mix without touching the ridges of the bottle.
Aliquot expansion medium into 50 ml aliquots in falcon tubes and store at -20°C.
Thaw one 50 ml aliquot in a 37°C water bath when needed.
Keep thawed expansion medium at 4°C for up to 1 week before use.
Pre-warm a small aliquot of reprogramming medium in a 37°C water bath prior to cell culture use.
Dilute 100 mg of VPA powder into 12 ml of expansion medium to make a 50 mM stock solution.
Sterilize the 50 mM VPA stock by filtering through a 0.2 μm syringe filter.
Add 1 ml from the 50 mM VPA stock to 50 ml of expansion medium to achieve a final concentration of 1 mM VPA.
Mix 6 ml of DMEM with 3 ml of FBS and then add 1 ml of DMSO to make freezing medium.
Store the freezing medium at 4°C until use.
Dissolve 5 g of BSA into 50 ml of DPBS in a 50 ml falcon tube.
Shake the falcon tube horizontally on a shaking plate until BSA fully dissolves.
Sterile filter the dissolved BSA-DPBS mixture using a 0.2 μm syringe filter to make a stock solution of 10% BSA.
Dilute 5 ml of the filtered 10% BSA solution with DPBS up to a final volume of 50 ml to prepare a 1% BSA solution.
Store the 1% BSA in DPBS at -20°C, thaw before use; keep at 4°C for up to 24 hours if necessary.
Collect human amniotic fluid after amniocentesis into a sterile syringe (typically 1-2 ml).
Transfer collected amniotic fluid to a 15 ml centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the resulting pellet in 1 ml of pre-warmed isolation medium and transfer to one well of a 6-well plate, adding an additional 2 ml of pre-warmed medium.
Check cells daily for attachment without changing the medium for the first week.
Replace the medium when the first colonies are forming (∼ 10-15 cells each).
Aspirate the medium from the well carefully without touching the bottom of the well.
Wash the well carefully with 2 ml of pre-warmed DPBS.
Replace with 3 ml of pre-warmed isolation medium.
Place the pipette end on the side of the well and release the solution very slowly to avoid disturbance of the colonies.
Allow the colonies to grow until 70% confluence has been reached, changing the medium every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
Passage the cells when the culture reaches 70% confluence.
Remove the medium and wash with DPBS as mentioned above.
Add 1 ml of Trypsin solution, swirl the plate gently to cover the surface evenly, and place back in the incubator for 2-3 minutes until cells detach.
Add 1 ml of isolation medium to neutralize the trypsin and collect in a 15 ml tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet slowly in 200 μl of isolation medium to obtain a single cell suspension.
Add a further 800 μl of isolation medium, resuspending slowly.
Add a further 2 ml of isolation medium and resuspend carefully, avoiding the formation of air bubbles.
Transfer 1 ml of cell suspension into each of 3 wells of a 6 well plate.
Add 2 ml of pre-warmed isolation medium to each well containing cells.
Place the plate in the incubator.
Remove the supernatant carefully and resuspend the pellet slowly in 200 μl of solution for cell separation to obtain a single cell suspension.
Add an additional 800 μl of solution for cell separation, resuspending slowly.
Count the cells using a haemocytometer or cell counter, using methylene blue to determine cell viability.
Wash the cells by adding 4 ml of running buffer and resuspending gently.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet as before.
Repeat wash two more times, centrifuging after each wash.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μl of AutoMACS running buffer, in a FACS round bottom tube.
Add 100 μl of CD117 microbeads.
Mix well and incubate at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Wash cells by adding 4 ml of running buffer and resuspending well.
Centrifuge at 300g for 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant completely and resuspend in 500 μl of running buffer.
Place an MS column in the magnetic field of the MACS separator.
Prime column by rinsing with 500 μl of running buffer.
Apply cell suspension to the column.
Collect the flow through that contains the unlabelled cells in a 15 ml falcon tube.
Wash column 3 times with 500 μl of running buffer, collecting the flow through in the same 15 ml tube.
After the washes, remove the separation column and place it in a 15ml falcon tube.
Add 1 ml of isolation medium onto the column and immediately flush out the CD117+ magnetically labelled cells by firmly pushing the plunger into the column.
Plate the cells in 6-well plates at a cell density of 2 x 10^5 cells/well, topping up with isolation medium to 3 ml per well.
First prepare Matrigel-coated plates and place the plates in the incubator with 2 ml per well of pre-warmed 1:1 isolation medium:expansion medium to equilibrate for a minimum of 10 minutes.
When the cells reach 70% confluence in isolation medium, detach the cells with trypsin as described in steps 8-11.
Resuspend the cells in 1 ml of a solution made of pre-warmed 1:1 isolation medium:expansion medium.
Count the cells and resuspend at a cell density of 2 x 10^5 cells/ml.
Add 1 ml of single cell suspension per well.
Check for cell viability the next day.
Replace the media with 3 ml of pre-warmed expansion medium per well.
Prepare Matrigel plates and place them in the incubator with 2 ml per well of pre-warmed expansion medium to equilibrate for a minimum of 10 minutes.
Pre-warm the collagenase in a 37°C water bath for 15 minutes.
Aspirate carefully the medium from the wells.
Add carefully 1 ml of collagenase on the side of the well without touching the cells.
Place the plate back in the incubator for 7 minutes, checking under light microscope after 5 minutes.
Carefully aspirate the collagenase from the side of the well without touching the cells.
Wash the well twice by gently pipetting 2 ml of room temperature DPBS on the side of the well.
Add 1 ml of pre-warmed expansion medium per well.
Gently scrape cells with a 1 ml pipette tip until cells are uniformly dispersed into small clumps (50 to 500 cells).
Add 2 ml of expansion medium.
Add 1 ml of cell suspension into one well of a 6-well plate.
Place the plate back into the incubator.
Prepare the reprogramming medium and pre-warm in a 37°C water bath for 15 minutes.
Remove the expansion medium from the cells and replace with 3 ml of pre-warmed reprogramming medium per well.
Change the medium daily, for 5 days in total.
After 5 days, extract RNA from one well and synthesize cDNA.
Using qRT-PCR, verify that the levels of expression of OCT4A, SOX2, c-MYC, KLF4, and FBX015 are upregulated.
Remove reprogramming medium and rinse cells carefully with 2 ml DPBS.
Replace the medium with 3 ml of pre-warmed expansion medium per well.
When the cells reach 70% confluence, either passage the cells by following steps 48-59 or freeze the cells.
Prepare EB differentiation medium by mixing 80% KO-DMEM, 1 mM L-glutamine, 0.1 mM β-mercaptoethanol, 1% non-essential amino acids stock, and 20% FBS.
Prepare immunofluorescence blocking solution by supplementing DPBS with 1% BSA, 0.2% fish skin gelatin, and 0.1% casein (pH 7.6).

Prepare hepatic differentiation medium by mixing high glucose DMEM with 15% FBS, 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin, 2 mM L-Glutamine, 300 μM Monothioglycerol, 20 ng/ml Hepatocyte Growth Factor, 10 ng/ml Oncostatin M, 10^-7 Dexamethasone, 100 ng/ml Fibroblast Growth Factor 4, and 1X ITS.

Prepare ectoderm differentiation medium by mixing DMEM/F12 (1:1) with 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin, 2 mM L-Glutamine, 0.6% glucose, 3 mM sodium bicarbonate, 5 mM HEPES buffer, 25 mg/ml insulin, 100 mg/ml transferrin, 20 nM progesterone, 60 mM putrescine, 30 nM selenium chloride, 20 ng/ml Epidermal Growth Factor, 10 ng/ml basic Fibroblast Growth Factor, and 10 ng/ml Leukemia Inhibitory Factor.
Detach the cells as described in steps 49-56.
Collect the cells in a 15 ml falcon tube and centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in 1 ml of flow cytometry buffer and count using a haemocytometer.
Wash the cells 3 times by resuspending in 4 ml of flow cytometry buffer and centrifuging at 300g for 5 minutes after each wash.
Stain cells with antibodies for cell surface markers CD105, CD24, CD29, CD90, SSEA3, SSEA4, TRA-1-60, TRA-1-81 for 1 hour at 4°C.
Wash the cells twice in 4 ml of flow cytometry buffer and centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes after each wash when using unconjugated primary antibodies.
Add secondary fluorochrome-conjugated antibody to the stained cells and incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Detach the cells as described in steps 49-56.
Collect the cells in a 15 ml falcon tube and centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in 1 ml of flow cytometry buffer and count using a haemocytometer.
Wash the cells 3 times by resuspending in 4 ml of flow cytometry buffer and centrifuging at 300g for 5 minutes after each wash.
Fix cells in 2 ml of 0.01% PFA for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash twice with 4 ml of DPBS, centrifuging at 300g for 5 minutes after each wash.
Resuspend the cells in DPBS with 1% vol/vol Triton and centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Stain cells with antibodies for 1 h at 4°C.
When using unconjugated primary antibodies, wash cells twice in 4 ml of flow cytometry buffer, centrifuging at 300g for 5 minutes after each wash.
Add secondary fluorochrome-conjugated antibody and incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells 3 times by resuspending in 4 ml of flow cytometry buffer and centrifuging at 300g for 5 minutes after each wash.
Scrape the cells using an 18 cm cell scraper to detach them in small clumps.
Check under the microscope to ensure all cells have detached from the surface of the well.
Plate the cells in a 100mm square low-attachment petri dish with 15 ml of EB differentiation medium.
Transfer cells to a 50 ml falcon tube and centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes twice per week.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 ml of EB differentiation medium using a 5 ml plastic disposable pipette.
Transfer the cell solution to a new low-attachment petri dish and add 10 ml of EB differentiation medium.
Allow the cells to develop into 15 day old embryoid bodies (EBs).
Transfer EB suspensions to gelatin-coated plates for another 7-10 days before fixation.
Fix EBs in 4% PFA.
Immunostain for markers representative of the three embryonic germ layers: NESTIN and PAX6 (ectoderm), BMP4 (primitive endoderm), CK3, CK19 (endoderm), GATA6 (mesoderm), or SYCP1 (testis).
Monitor concomitant down-regulation of OCT4A.
Fix cells on coverslips in 4% PFA in 125 mM HEPES (pH 7.6) for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove 4% PFA and replace with 8% PFA in the same buffer for 50 minutes at 4°C.
Remove 8% PFA and wash cells twice with DPBS per well.
Transfer coverslips into a 24-well plate (1 coverslip per well).
Permeabilize cells in 0.5% Triton in DPBS for 30 min at room temperature.
Remove Triton solution and wash cells six times with DPBS.
Incubate cells with 20 mM glycine in DPBS for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Remove glycine solution and wash cells three times with DPBS.
Incubate cells with immunofluorescence blocking solution for 1 hour at room temperature.
Incubate cells with primary antibodies diluted in immunofluorescence blocking solution for 2 hours at room temperature.
Wash cells every 20 minutes with immunofluorescence blocking solution, repeating five times.
Incubate the cells with secondary antibodies diluted in immunofluorescence blocking solution for 2 hours at room temperature.
Wash the cells in immunofluorescence blocking solution overnight at 4°C.
Wash the cells three times with DPBS.
Mount the coverslips using a drop of VectaShield containing DAPI.
Detach cells as described in steps 49-56.
Collect the cells in a 15 ml falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Extract RNA from the pellet using the RNeasy minikit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Synthesise cDNA using the Reverse transcription system kit, according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Prepare one mastermix per gene of interest containing SYBR green PCR mastermix, custom oligonucleotide pairs and water.
Aliquot into each well of a MicroAmp fast 96-well reaction plate.
Run each gene in triplicate for each sample.
Add cDNA (10-20 ng) to each well.
Mix the cDNA into the mastermix.
Detach 2x10^6 cells as described in steps 49-56.
Collect the cells in a 15 ml falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 30% (vol/vol) Matrigel on ice.
Inject the cells subcutaneously into the dorsal flank of 8-12 week old common γ chain -/-, RAG2-/-, C5-/- immunodeficient mice without preconditioning.
Observe mice for the growth of solid tumours up to 12 weeks or up to 10mm3 tumour volume.
Dissect the formed teratomas.
Proceed with histopathological and immunohistochemical analysis to confirm the presence of cell and tissue derivatives from all three embryonic germ layers.
Detach 2x10^6 cells as described in steps 49-56.
Collect the cells in a 15 ml falcon tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 300g for 5 minutes.
Seed cells at a concentration of 5000 cells/cm^2 on tissue culture plastic plates and coverslips coated with Matrigel in 3 ml isolation medium per well.
Remove the isolation medium after 3 days.
Wash each well carefully with 2 ml DPBS.
Add 3 ml of pre-warmed hepatic differentiation medium per well.
Replace the medium every 3 days for a total of 21 days.
Collect the supernatant after each medium change.
Store the collected supernatant at -80°C for analysis.
Fix the cells with 4% (vol/vol) PFA after 21 days.
Proceed with immunofluorescence analysis for AFP and ALBUMIN expression.
Measure urea in the supernatant using a Urea/Ammonia determination kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Seed cells at a concentration of 3000 cells/cm² on tissue culture plastic plates and coverslips coated with Matrigel in 3 ml of pre-warmed ectoderm differentiation medium.
Replace the medium every 3 days for 21 days in total.
After 21 days, fix the cells with 4% vol/vol PFA.
Proceed with immunofluorescence analysis for the expression of NESTIN and VIMENTIN.
Detach 2x10^6 cells as described in steps 49-56.
Collect the cells in a 15 ml falcon tube and centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes.
Seed cells at a concentration of 5000 cells/cm² on tissue culture plastic plates and coverslips coated with Matrigel in 3 ml of isolation medium for 1 day.
Remove the isolation medium from the wells.
Wash with 2 ml of DPBS.
Replace with 3 ml of pre-warmed, freshly made neuronal differentiation medium per well.
Add one co-culture membrane insert per well.
Plate C17.2 mouse neural progenitor cells at a concentration of 10,000 cells/cm² into the insert.
Allow the cells to differentiate for 5 days without changing the medium.
Detach 2x10^6 cells as described in steps 49-56.
Collect the cells in a 15 ml falcon tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 300g for 5 minutes.
Seed cells at a concentration of 5000 cells/cm^2 on tissue culture plastic plates and coverslips coated with Matrigel in 3 ml of oligodendrocyte differentiation medium.
Plate CG4 rat oligodendrocyte progenitor cells at a concentration of 10,000 cells/cm^2 into the insert the following day.
Replace the medium every 2 days with 3 ml of pre-warmed oligodendrocyte differentiation medium per well for 5 days in total.
After 5 days, fix the cells with 4% (vol/vol) PFA.
Proceed with immunofluorescence analysis for the expression of the oligodendrocyte markers O2 and NG2.
